zipCodeComparison.neighborhoodsIncluded: Montclair Township Central, North, South, and Hill sections
keyFindings: Homeowners fund 83.2% of the total property tax levy in Montclair Township.
Average annual property tax check is $23,217.39, representing 15.0% of median household income.
Public school district receives 57.2% of every property tax dollar paid by residents.

neighborhoods.name: Upper Montclair & Bellevue Ave
neighborhoods.character: Upscale shopping village, pedestrian bistros, Upper Montclair commuter rail station, grand Tudors, and colonials
neighborhoods.description: Northern village center anchored by Anderson Park, historic Iris Gardens, and charming boutiques along Bellevue Avenue.
neighborhoods.taxDynamic: Highest residential assessed values in Montclair, paying substantial share of township school taxes.

neighborhoods.name: Watchung & Montclair Center
neighborhoods.character: Arts and cultural center along Bloomfield Avenue, historic Wellmont Theater, diverse dining, lofts, and pre-war colonials
neighborhoods.description: Vibrant downtown cultural corridor featuring the Montclair Art Museum, independent bookstores, and transit-oriented apartments.
neighborhoods.taxDynamic: Subject to active municipal PILOT redevelopment discussions at Lackawanna Plaza and Seymour Street.

neighborhoods.name: South End & Nishuane Park
neighborhoods.character: Historic multicultural neighborhood with Victorian frame homes, two-families, and community parks
neighborhoods.description: Historic residential community surrounding Nishuane Park and Orange Road business district.
neighborhoods.taxDynamic: Higher effective tax burden relative to household income creates strong local demand for property tax stabilization.

keyTakeaways.title: Why Schools Take 57.2% of Every Tax Check in Montclair Township
keyTakeaways.detail: Because Montclair Township is classified as an affluent suburban district under NJ SFRA school aid formulas, State Aid covers roughly 10% of educational spending. Local property taxpayers must fund the remaining ~90%.

keyTakeaways.title: Commercial Ratable Retention vs. PILOT Burdens
keyTakeaways.detail: Commercial ratables represent 16.8% of Montclair Township's tax base. Protecting business ratables while ensuring that new luxury developments pay their fair share to the school district is the central taxpayer challenge.
